quotes.quote: If the world was going to end tomorrow, I'd tell you I like you. Then I'd turn to space dust.
I don't want anyone else to see you like this, Hori-san.
I like you, Hori-san. Not just the you at school, but the you at home, too.
I'm in love with you Hori-san, have been for a while now.
The world I saw back then was just a small part of it. A very, very small part.
I didn't fall in love with a 'normal girl.' I fell in love with you.
